license: Original code written for Exhibit A; no third-party code vendored (see README.md).
note: Self-contained oracle case. It installs no third-party package and is not replay-driven: it is proven directly with effect='canary_sql' against the SQLite database run.sql_db declares (a copy of it is seeded with the canary table; the original is never touched). No upstream repo/commit applies because the vulnerable code is original synthetic code written for this case.

real_world_analog.fix: Build the statement with bound parameters instead of string formatting, and convert numeric ids to integers. This case uses an original, equivalent containment (parameters plus int()).
real_world_analog.summary: SQL injection in auth_login.php of Cacti 0.8.5a: the username and password parameters reached the login statement, allowing arbitrary SQL and authentication bypass. The pattern is request input reaching a login statement by string building.
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search (NVD entry) on 2026-10-31; the app in this case is original synthetic code, not Cacti.

bypass.expectation: proven against fixed_incomplete: the account id is placed in the statement without quotes, so an escape that only doubles single quotes does not stop a quote-free UNION; the incomplete fix must not be accepted as fixed.
